resources.string: The language of the server\'s own words, and of the devices whose language Pley isn\'t in yet. Each person can choose their own on their Account page.
Posters, summaries, ratings, cast and episode titles.
Movies, collections and Fix Match use TMDB. Free key from themoviedb.org/settings/api. Without one, movies keep their file names and local artwork, or what their NFO files say.
Automatic uses TMDB when it has a key, then TheTVDB when it has one, else TVmaze, which needs none. Changing the source fetches every show again.
Only needed to use TheTVDB for TV shows. Get one at thetvdb.com/api-information.
User-supported keys also need your subscriber PIN. Leave empty for other keys.
Genres and release dates from MusicBrainz, and covers from the Cover Art Archive for albums that have none. Tags in the files win. No key needed; the first look-up takes about a second per album.

The NFO files Kodi, Jellyfin, Radarr and Sonarr keep next to movies and shows: their ids decide the match, and their details win over the metadata source\'s. Your edits win over them. Pley never changes them.
For TMDB and TheTVDB. TVmaze is in English.
This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB. TV metadata from TheTVDB. TV data from TVmaze is licensed CC BY-SA; music data from MusicBrainz is public domain.
Find subtitles for a movie or episode on OpenSubtitles, from the player\'s subtitle menu.
Each server needs its own key: create a consumer at opensubtitles.com/consumers. Without one, subtitle search is off.
Optional. Downloads count against this account\'s daily quota instead of the key\'s smaller one.
Left empty, the saved password stays.
Pick up new, changed and deleted files automatically.
Compare the audio of episodes in the background to offer Skip Intro and Skip Credits. Chapters named Intro or Credits are always used.
This FFmpeg lacks Chromaprint, so only chapters can mark intros and credits.
Make the thumbnails shown above the seek bar, in the background, the first time a movie or episode is opened.
After each scan, make missing seek previews and chapter pictures.
Minutes between full scans. 0 disables periodic scans.
Finding intros and credits, and previews for whole libraries. They always wait while something plays; what someone opens or is watching goes first, at any hour.

Shows people are watching, titles on their lists and what\'s new go first, at any hour. The rest waits for the hours people rarely watch, which the server learns.
Learned from what played over the last weeks, recent ones counting most, in the server\'s time.
Still learning: until about a week of playback is known, the rest of the libraries goes on whenever nothing plays.
Library work waits while other programs keep more of the processors busy than this.

resources.string: The server can\'t use its secret.key, so authenticator apps can\'t be set up or checked. Until it can, people who haven\'t set up two-step sign-in can\'t sign in, and people who have sign in with a recovery code. Its log says why.
Pley\'s own apps can always sign in. Turn this on to let people allow other publishers\' apps; turning it off signs them out.
Turn off apps by other publishers?
The apps by other publishers that people allowed are signed out at once.
